version.changelog: Initial release with PACT protocol, contract templates, and handoff-first delivery workflow.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agentic-coding
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle consists entirely of markdown documentation and a metadata JSON file, with no executable code. The instructions for the AI agent, primarily in SKILL.md and setup.md, define a structured, contract-first coding workflow. Crucially, the skill explicitly disclaims network requests, access outside its designated local memory path (~/agentic-coding/), and writing to global stores, reinforcing a secure and transparent operational model. All instructions are geared towards guiding the agent's behavior for a disciplined coding process, with an emphasis on user approval and evidence-based actions, rather than subverting its purpose or performing harmful actions.

llm.summary: This skill is a transparent coding-workflow guide that stores optional local notes and does not contain hidden execution, network, credential, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The only disclosed data handling is local task memory under ~/agentic-coding/, and the skill explicitly says it does not trigger undeclared network requests or access files outside its own memory path.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown instructions/templates only, with no executable scripts, bundled dependencies, remote payload retrieval, or install-time commands beyond normal skill installation metadata.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation guidance is somewhat broad, but setup explicitly asks the user to clarify when the skill should activate and says persistence requires approval.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill can create persistent local notes in ~/agentic-coding/, including activation preferences and validation patterns, but it keeps this opt-in and excludes global memory stores or external configuration files.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is contract-first AI-assisted coding with acceptance checks, minimal diffs, validation evidence, and handoff notes; the artifact content matches that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, decide whether you want the skill to activate only on request or during higher-risk coding tasks. If enabled, expect it to keep local workflow notes under ~/agentic-coding/; review or delete that folder if you do not want persistent coding preferences retained.
llm.findings:
[EA2] expected: The flagged text is a negative security statement saying the skill does not auto-approve risky code without evidence; artifact review did not find autonomous high-impact approval or destructive execution instructions.
[SQP-1] expected: The setup file uses broad activation concepts, but it directs the agent to ask the user for activation preferences and save them only if approved, so this is a usability/scoping note rather than a security hold.
